landing.metaTitle: {{serviceName}} — QR-code digital menu for cafes and restaurants
landing.metaDescription: Get a QR-code digital menu up in 1 day: first month free, no apps, no order commissions. Great for coffee shops, small cafes, street food and bars.
landing.heroEyebrow: A digital menu for your business
landing.heroSubtitle: One QR code on the table — and the guest instantly sees the menu on their phone. No apps, no queues.
landing.heroFreeNote: First month free · no card required · live in 1 day
landing.heroTrustText: Venues in Tashkent and Fergana are already using qr.menu
landing.featureBilingualDesc: Guests switch between RU/UZ themselves, while you fill in each dish's name and description separately for each language.
landing.featurePhotosDesc: Upload a photo from your phone — the service converts it to WebP, a thumbnail and a full-size version, so the menu loads fast even on slow internet.
landing.featureCategoriesDesc: Add and edit categories and dishes from the dashboard — changes appear on the public page instantly.
landing.featureStopListDesc: A dish ran out — one switch hides it or marks it unavailable, without removing it from the menu.
landing.featureDiscountDesc: Set an old price next to the new one — it shows crossed out next to the discount on the public page.
landing.featureCompositionDesc: You can add ingredients and calorie count to any dish — optional fields, entirely up to you.
landing.featureCartDesc: Guests put together a list of dishes and show it to the waiter — the order doesn't go to the kitchen automatically, it's a prompt for the floor staff.
landing.featureQrDesc: A print-ready design — download it and place it on tables or at the entrance.
landing.featureVenueCardDesc: Cover photo, logo, description, cuisine and district, rating, working hours — guests see the venue, not just a list of dishes.
landing.featureContactsDesc: Phone, address with a 2GIS link, social media and the Wi-Fi password — right in the menu, no need to ask the waiter.
landing.featureSeoDesc: The menu link unfolds into a nice preview card in Telegram and Instagram.
landing.featureStatsDesc: See in your dashboard how many guests have opened your menu.
landing.forWhomNote: The service is built for small venues, not chains running iiko or similar systems — no complex setup, no extra modules.
landing.step1Desc: Message us on Telegram — tell us about your venue and send your dish list with prices and photos.
landing.step2Title: We build your menu and hand you a QR code
landing.step2Desc: We enter all categories and items into the system ourselves and send you a print-ready QR code.
landing.step3Desc: The menu opens in the browser from the QR code on the table — no app installation needed.
landing.howFreeNote: First month free — you only pay if it works for you.
landing.why1Old: Reprinting the menu every time prices change
landing.why1New: Prices change in 10 seconds from your phone
landing.why2New: A fixed monthly fee, no commissions
landing.why3New: Full RU and UZ versions, guests switch themselves
landing.why4New: A real person replies, in Russian and Uzbek
landing.why5New: Hosting built for Uzbekistan — opens fast even on 3G
landing.why6New: We build your first menu for you
landing.planSub: No order commissions. No hidden fees. Cancel anytime.
landing.planFeature2: We fill in your first menu for you
landing.planFeature3: Telegram support in Russian and Uzbek
landing.pricesIntro: One plan means you don't have to pick a package or pay extra for individual features. Everything the service can do is included from the start: from the QR code to view statistics. No upsells, no hidden fees.
landing.pricesFreeMonthDesc: The free month is counted from when your menu goes live, not from signup — plenty of time to get everything set up. You only start paying from the second month.
landing.pricesPerk3: We help with photos and descriptions
landing.pricesAfterFreeHeading: What happens after the free month?
landing.pricesAfterFreeDesc: The menu keeps working, then it's {{price}} a month. No surprises, no charges without a warning.
landing.faqQ1: What happens after the free month?
landing.faqA1: The menu keeps working, then it's {{price}} a month. We'll always warn you in advance — nothing gets disabled without a reminder.
landing.faqQ2: Do guests need to install an app?
landing.faqA2: No. The menu opens in the browser from a QR code or link — nothing to download.
landing.faqQ3: How many dishes can I add?
landing.faqA3: There's no limit on the number of categories or items.
landing.faqQ4: Who enters the menu the first time?
landing.faqA4: We enter your first menu ourselves from the dish list, prices and photos you send us — after that you can edit everything yourself.
landing.faqA5: Yes, you can change any item's price in the dashboard at any time — changes show on the public page instantly.
landing.faqA6: Cash or card transfer — we send the details once you're connected. Online card payment is coming later.
landing.faqQ7: What if I want to cancel?
landing.faqA7: You can cancel anytime, with no penalties or future obligations.
landing.faqQ8: Does the menu work without internet for the guest?
landing.faqA8: No, the guest needs internet to open the menu — but the page is lightweight and loads fast even on a slow mobile connection.
landing.ctaFinalText: Check out the demo menu or message us on Telegram — we'll reply and help you get connected.
